profile.title: My Profile
css.help: Changes the look of the whole site, just for you. Only paste CSS from people you trust. Tip: :root { --accent: #ff7eb6; } changes the accent color on every screen, and [data-page="editor"] body { ... } targets a single screen. If something doesn't change, try !important. If something disappears, open the site with ?safe=1 at the end of the link. Don't want to touch code? Build your theme. Need help? CSS guide.
